english.title: Negligently interfered with the pipe, structure, installation or apparatus of a water supply licensee
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the consent of the water supply licensee, by an act or omission, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT OR OMISSION..), negligently interfered with

(A)_[a pipe vested in]_
(B)_[a structure, namely **(..SPECIFY STRUCTURE..), belonging to]_
(C)_[an installation, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTALLATION..), belonging to]_
(D)_[apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..), belonging to]_

(E)_[that licensee,]_
(F)_[a water supply licensee, namely **(..SPECIFY LICENSEE..),]_

so as to damage it or so as to have an effect on its use or operation
english.legislation: Contrary to section 174(1A)(b) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
by an act or omission, negligently interfered with a pipe vested or a structure, installation or apparatus belonging to
a water supply so as to damage it or so as to have an effect on its use or operation
